finding: GitHub's repository workflow-run endpoint documents a maximum of 1,000 results for filtered searches including head_sha and created, while per_page is capped at 100. Exact-commit retrieval therefore remains absence-unproven whenever a filtered window reaches the ceiling unless the search space is partitioned and every leaf is independently paginated.
